lstm.scaler: MinMaxScaler, normal internal fit rows only, clip=False
lstm.score: last-observation mean squared error over 3 sensors

selection.primary: all-observation operational 3-seed ensemble; selection FPR<=0.01, then Recall desc, F1 desc, AP desc, measured fit+score runtime asc, model key asc
selection.alternative: same candidates, maximize F1 then Recall then AP then runtime
selection.no_eligible: report no compliant candidate; descriptive fallback minimum FPR then maximum Recall
selection.common_rows: intersection across every base model and every window, frozen before scores
selection.seed_policy: report every seed and sample mean/std, use fixed equal-weight three-seed score ensemble for operation; never select best seed

operational_score: For each seed/model, map raw scores by piecewise-linear normal-calibration quantiles to normal z units, extrapolating tails using last distinct segment. Use M2 normalized score where window unavailable. Average seeds. Recalibrate threshold on entire normal calibration operational distribution. Not a probability.

auxiliary.sensor_combinations: M2 all 7 nonempty subsets, three seeds; descriptive development only
auxiliary.feature_ablation: M4 L10 leave one of 15 features out, three seeds, target FPR .01; development only
auxiliary.matched_count: for M0/M1 and M3/M4 at each L where burst-aware improves development common-row F1 or Recall at .01: downsample unaware train endpoints with deterministic seed to aware count, preserve early-stop count separately
auxiliary.probability: nonnegative-slope regularized sigmoid fitted only calibration normal+anomaly labels, report selection/test Brier/log loss/reliability against constant calibration prevalence and explicitly uncalibrated sigmoid proxy; no threshold retuning
auxiliary.error_bins: normal-train sensor magnitude/current difference quartiles, position <=L-1, burst length <L; no physical condition claims
auxiliary.uncertainty: three seed variation only; no independent-failure or row-iid confidence intervals

test_gate: Do not compute test scores before selection_lock.json exists. Test results cannot change settings. Previously viewed full-data summaries acknowledged.

guidebook.reason: PyTorch structural adaptation with common fixed splits, 5/10/20 windows, shorter CPU budget, internal normal early stopping, endpoint label and normal-calibration threshold; no original 100-step future-label claim
